summary.text: Rob Hunter is a Democratic state representative from Vermont who has represented the Bennington-4 District since January 2025 and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Rob Hunter earned a bachelor's degree from Hartwick College in 1986.
According to Ballotpedia, his career experience includes working as a writer.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on August 11, 2026.
